subject: Final go/no-go: MAP checkpoints, security signoffs, and staggered Day 0 start coordination
messages:
From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@orbitai.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com, camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP & evaluation — readiness check

Vanessa / Camila,

Thanks for the test run last week. Our engineering and security leads reviewed the evaluation deliverables and we have three items blocking procurement:

- Final signed mutual action plan (we need a version with a clear signature order)
- SOC2 artifact and encryption/KMS answers for onboarding
- Confirmation of start-week (Day 0) window so we can schedule internal resources

Procurement asked that we lock signature timing before they issue the PO; they can move quickly once the MAP and SOW are in place.

Can we propose a single-pack signature window and a fallback plan if an approver misses the primary slot?

—Jordan
Jordan Ellis
VP Product, OrbitAI

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@orbitai.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP & evaluation — readiness check

Jordan — thanks. Draft attached: MAP_v3.pdf (summary + signature lanes). High level plan below: please confirm by EOD Wednesday so we can lock procurement and legal windows.

Mutual action plan (summary)
- Evaluation signoffs: PASS (performance + latency tests completed 11/27)
- Security evidence: SOC2 snapshot requested; Redwood to provide artifacts and a live SSO/KMS Q&A (see attachment list)
- Legal: standard Redwood term sheet with two optional SLA tiers (attached)

Proposed signature sequencing (primary window)
- Dec 6–8, 09:00–17:00 PST (three timezones covered)
- DocuSign flow: OrbitAI > Procurement approver > OrbitAI legal > Redwood legal > Redwood ops
- Fallback: if any signatory misses slot, escalate to alternate approver within 24 hours; if unresolved, auto-fallback to Dedicated-lower-tier with a 7-day onboarding delay

Start-week (Day 0) plan
- Preferred Day 0 start: Mon Dec 13, 2026 — this gives procurement and legal a 5-business-day window after signatures to complete PO and payment setup
- If signature slips more than 5 business days, projected Day 0 moves to Dec 20 with a staged onboarding cadence (demo + config + pilot)

Attachments: MAP_v3.pdf, SLA_term_sheet.docx (term options), SOC2 request checklist

Ask: Jordan — share the final signer names + timezones (we need explicit DocuSign emails). Camila & Karthik, can Legal/Security confirm we can produce SOC2 snapshot + KMS notes by Wednesday EOD?

Thanks — Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Lead, Redwood Inference

Vanessa,

2) Copy of Redwood W-9 / vendor onboarding form (we can take on the 30-day net terms)

> Vanessa,
>
> Procurement here. Quick items we need to proceed with PO issuance:

Team — short legal/security update:
- Legal redlines: majority accepted; only pending clause: data residency section (OrbitAI requested EU-only for backups). I propose the following: accept primary residency as US (hosted), add a 90‑day roadmap to evaluate Private/VPC staging for EU backups. That gives them a path without gating Day 0.
- SOC2 artifacts: attached SOC2_evidence.zip — contains control narratives and recent audit snapshot (redacted). Security will host a 45-minute KMS/keys Q&A on Fri Dec 4 (proposed).
- SLA: two tiers in SLA_term_sheet.docx — recommend Tier A (4hr P1) for launch customers; procurement can pick Tier B to trade off cost.

If Procurement confirms PO terms and OrbitAI can supply final DocuSign emails by Dec 4 COB, we can keep Dec 6–8 signature window. Otherwise we shift to Dec 13–15.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@orbitai.com>, Procurement <procurement@orbitai.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com

Subject: FINAL: decision request — signers, DocuSign envelope, and Day 0 lock

Team / Jordan / Aisha — pulling a final decision together. Please treat this as the official go/no-go request.

Summary of status:
- Evaluation: green — passed perf + integration tests (11/27)
- Legal: one residency roadmap item (will not block Day 0 if OrbitAI agrees to 90-day evaluation)
- Security: SOC2 snapshot delivered; KMS Q&A scheduled for Fri 12/04 10:00 PST
- Procurement: awaiting vendor form + final DocuSign emails

Decision requested by: Mon 12/06 12:00 PST
If we receive: final signer emails + procurement confirmation by that deadline -> Proceed with primary signature window Dec 6–8 and Day 0 = Mon Dec 13.
If we do NOT receive by deadline -> fallback: push signature window to Dec 13–15, Day 0 = Dec 20 and apply a phased onboarding (pilot day 1 = separate runbook).

DocuSign sequencing (final proposed)
1) OrbitAI Product Requestor (parallel with Procurement)
2) OrbitAI Procurement (parallel)
3) OrbitAI Legal (sequential)
4) Redwood Legal (sequential)
5) Redwood Ops (final)

Please reply with the following as separate bullets: 1) "SIGNED: <name> - email" for each OrbitAI signer, 2) Procurement confirmation line (PO terms & vendor onboarding), 3) any blocker that prevents Dec 6–8.

Thanks — this will be the last coordination email before we create the envelope. I will circulate the DocuSign link once you confirm signers.

Vanessa Ortiz
